basic_info.chief_complaint: The crown made by an outside hospital fell off and required to be glued back

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: The crown made by an outside hospital fell off and required to be glued back

oral_examination.oral_examination: All-ceramic crowns, 11th dental implant, red and swollen gums around the abutment, and bleeding on probing. 21 is a natural tooth with no obvious abnormalities.

treatment_plan.definitive: It was recommended that the crown be re-made. The patient requested that the original crown be directly bonded back. He informed that subsequent problems with the crown, abutment teeth, implants, etc. had nothing to do with this bonding.

source_handle: The abutment teeth and crowns are cleaned and glass ionomer bonded.
